== `pixi` Data Science Project Template ==
:cookiecutter:dsproject:python:pixi:

- Alternative project scaffold template tools
  - [[/diary/2026-04-05#dsproject|PyScaffold]]
  - [[/diary/2020-10-24#dsproject|Cookiecutter Conda Project Template]]
- [[https://prefix.dev/tools/pixi|Prefix.dev Pixi]]

{{{bash
cookiecutter gh:jfishe/cookiecutter-uv-dsproject

cd <my-ds-project>
pixi init
pixi workspace platform add "win-64"
pixi install
}}}

=== pixi-cookiecutter ===
:act:direnv:GitHub-CLI:pixi:ruff:ty:pytest:pre-commit:codecov:Github:

[[https://github.com/jevandezande/pixi-cookiecutter|jevandezande / pixi-cookiecutter]]
  Cookiecutter for setting up python projects with `pixi` that just work

- [X] Packaging with [pixi](https://prefix.dev/)
- [X] Environment loading with [direnv](https://direnv.net/)
- [X] Formatting and linting with [ruff](https://github.com/charliermarsh/ruff)
- [X] Static typing with [ty](https://github.com/astral-sh/ty)
- [X] Testing with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/en/latest/)
- [X] Git hooks that run all the above with [pre-commit](https://pre-commit.com/)
- [X] Continuous integration with [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/features/actions)
- [X] Code coverage with [Codecov](https://docs.codecov.com/docs)
- [[https://github.com/jevandezande/pixi-cookiecutter/blob/master/notes.md#notes|notes.md]] lists optional dependencies:
  - [X] [[https://github.com/nektos/act|act]] runs GitHub Actions locally.
  - [X] [[https://pixi.sh/latest/integration/third_party/direnv|direnv]] can auto magically load environment variables and the `pixi` shell.
        👎 `direnv` is not optional.
  - [X] [[https://cli.github.com/|GitHub-CLI]] can create and manage a GitHub repository.
        [[/diary/2026-05-01|Journal 2026-05-01]] evaluates `GitHub-CLI`.
{{{text
OSError: direnv is not installed; install with `pixi global install direnv`
}}}
- 👎 `tests/` includes `__init__.py`.
- 👎 The python package is not isolated in `src/`.
- 👎 Platform does not include "win-64".
- 👍 Performs linting, formatting, type checking, and testing,
  using `pre-commit`, with `repo: local`.
- 👍 Replace `Makefile` with pixi tasks.

{{{bash
pixi global install direnv

cookiecutter gh:jevandezande/pixi-cookiecutter

pixi task remove --feature=dev test &&
pixi task add --feature=dev test "pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing"
}}}

== Universal-Ctags Configuration for Pixi ==
:ctags:pixi:

Ctags looks for configuration in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and
`$HOME/.config`.
